element.reason: DS-COMPLETE round 3 (D3, option a): breadcrumbs, title, description, record facts and up to two actions over the stock card header, centred over the stock empty header for contact.header. Composed through the Designer create path from pinned stock aria-nova parts only (components.badge, components.breadcrumbs, components.button, components.card, components.empty); no raw styled markup, no restyle of a part, every word a Writer copy prop. v3 names the part slots in deps.registry (v2 named the breadcrumb file, which maps to no slot). Replaces v1 (original lineage, failing ref-verbatim).
